name: pia
description: PIA — Principal Investigator's Assistant. A private research workspace for people, projects and deadlines, with an optional AI connection.

scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Your private workspace password. Use a unique password of at least 16 characters.

SESSION_SECRET.description: A separate random secret, at least 32 characters, used to protect sign-in sessions.

APP_ORIGIN.description: After first deployment, set this to your exact HTTPS Worker URL (without a trailing slash). Until then the app stays locked.
